Ma'am, First of all, thank you for what you are doing in the area of financial literacy. Wish you success in your current stint. 

I had a general question - I am currently 30 years old and sufficiently covered through my employer's insurance. I plan to retire at 45. If I take up a fresh comprehensive health care policy at 45, will my premium be more than that if I would take up a policy now and continue to renew it? Let's assume that I do not make any claim against & I stay fit till 45 yrs.

Thanks you Sourav jee, I am glad that you find the videos helpful :)

Answering your question - For policy now vs at the age of 45, you will be charged the same premium. The only catch is whether the health condition will be the same and you will be able to get the policy then.
